LESSON: FIRE SAFETY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 1.1: Fire Safety

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Fire Safety
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is fire safety important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment
2. explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment
• Model 2: explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment
2. Practise: explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Fire Safety.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is fire safety important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment
• explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
